bsi.editorial_reason: Genesis 11:3 narrates brick making, with no word for a brick mold or kiln, while Exodus 5:7 requires straw for bricks, not a mold. These two narrative contextual keys are wrongly attributed to the specific physical implement rather than brick production. Preserve the source-attested brick/brickmold implement at 2 Samuel 12:31 and Nahum 3:14; do not force an original implement where the text only mentions bricks.
editorial_evidence: Pinned WLC Genesis 11:3 describes making and baking bricks without a mold or implement word
